proposals: DGCI&S should publish TradeStat imports by country of origin alongside country of consignment, at least at the 2-digit chapter level, so that Hong Kong and Singapore rankings no longer mix re-exports with goods made there and China’s true share can be measured.

DPIIT should publish an official mapping of every PLI scheme’s eligible products to HS codes, with the import value each scheme covers, so that coverage of India’s fastest-growing import chapters is assessed by government rather than by independent reconstruction.

The Ministry of Steel should report specialty-steel output under PLI each year against the 42 million tonne target, alongside HS72 imports by supplier country, so that the stated aim ‘to reduce imports significantly’ can be checked against the trade data.

DPIIT should report domestic output of White Goods PLI components — compressors, copper tubes, aluminium foils — each year alongside matching HS84 import values, so that the scheme’s effect on the +68.8% machinery chapter is visible.
